items.compatibility: Scooby GTA5 native saved-paintjob JSON. Enter a vehicle, choose the preset’s folder and file, then select Load Paint Job.

items.name: homecom (Add-On Ped)
items.description: Complete native RDR2 addon ped resources with install.xml, ped metadata and supporting streaming files. Download the ZIP and import it through Addons/Replacements.
items.credits: AddonPeds RDR2; original package instructions retained
requirements: A compatible Scooby RDR2 build with Addons/Replacements
Keep the full resource set together
Lenny’s Mod Loader when using next-launch LML staging
items.compatibility: Native RDR2 resource format and declared file dependencies checked. Live game loading and registration remain unverified; use the menu’s validation and registration controls.

items.name: RSG farming prop 01
items.description: Native RedM prop from the original public RSG collection. Download the complete model, texture and archetype resource set together.
items.credits: RexShack / RSG source collection; original author files linked directly.
items.license: No redistribution license was established; these original public files are linked without mirroring.
requirements: A compatible RedM server resource
Keep all supplied model/texture/archetype files in its stream folder
Register stream/prop_weed_ytyp.ytyp with the source resource’s DLC_ITYP_REQUEST data-file declaration
items.compatibility: RedM streaming resource files verified against the public Git revision. Native single-player Scooby RDR2 import compatibility is not established.
